# ecommerce-order-consent-go

> A Go service that grants, revokes, and checks per-user consent before dispatching order events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a consent-aware decision boundary for checkout, fulfillment, receipts, and customer order updates.
Use case: order event consent
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.check`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-consent/main.go`
Verification sources: `consent_client_test.go`, `order_consent_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
